resolution.note: lead-file-read and the gauge ceiling skip KRN_SESSION_CLASS=lane (already set by sessionEnvironment); other guards untouched; tests cover lane vs lead

title: Headless lane sessions are exempt from lead-only read and gauge guards
body:
Why: Qwen second audit .krn/runs/qwen-research-2/report.md N2, verified at 6d713ae: scripts/claude/lead-file-read.ts:159 exempts only hook payloads with agent_id, so a headless krn lane run session (a main session) gets lead read refusals, and context-gauge refuses all work past the ceiling though a headless session cannot hand off.
Outcome: lead-file-read and the context-gauge ceiling refusal skip headless lane sessions (mark them by an env var krn lane run already sets, e.g. KRN_SESSION_CLASS=lane, or the harness's non-interactive signal); safety guards (bash-guards, piped-check, stash, unpushed-delete) still apply.
Proof: tests for lead-file-read and context-gauge show a lane-marked payload passes and a lead payload is still refused.
